newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.

text.p: Robert Fleming & Co Ltd reiterated its buy recommendation on Brazilian telecoms holding Telebras after release of second-quarter 1997 results.
-- "Telebras' results in the second quarter of the year were very strong and broke historic levels," Flemings analyst William Laurent said in a report.
-- He cited in particular "excellent" June figures, which he said were "very important as June was the first full month with new tariffs in place."
-- The results of Telebras' main subsidiaries were impressive, especially Telemig serving Minas Gerais state, he added.
-- "We can expect even stronger figures when price elasticity of demand kicks in," Laurent said.
-- He also noted Telebras' net cash position rose in three months to 2.532 billion reais from 577 million reais.
-- Telebras' preferred share ended off 2.63 percent at 148 reais and its common fell 2.87 percent to close off 135.50 reais in Sao Paulo.
